Package com.j3d.engine.react.events.payloads

Class SelectionEventPayload

java.lang.Object
com.j3d.engine.react.events.EventPayload<SelectionMouseOwner>
com.j3d.engine.react.events.payloads.SelectionEventPayload
public class SelectionEventPayload extends EventPayload<SelectionMouseOwner>
Event payload for when objects are selected.

This stores the HashSet of GObjects that have been selected.

Lehlogonolo Poole
